description: Backends for tools/eval. Each backend is a command template run once per eval case. The tokens {system_prompt} and {prompt} are substituted per argument (whole-argument replacement). Adding an API or local-model backend requires only a new entry here whose cmd points at an adapter that accepts the same substitutions on stdin/args -- no code changes to tools/eval.

substitution.vendor: who supplies the model. Recorded so claims about Alma surviving a vendor change can be checked rather than asserted; today every backend is one vendor.
